schema:
CREATE TABLE departments (dept_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, dept_name TEXT);
CREATE TABLE employees (emp_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, dept_id INTEGER, bonus INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY (dept_id) REFERENCES departments(dept_id));
correct_query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dept_name = 'Sales' THEN e.bonus ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN d.dept_name = 'Sales' THEN e.emp_id ELSE NULL END) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dept_name = 'Engineering' THEN e.bonus ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN d.dept_name = 'Engineering' THEN e.emp_id ELSE NULL END) FROM departments AS d INNER JOIN employees AS e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id
